records.subject: Welcome aboard, Harbor Media
records.body:
Hi Zara,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Project created day 2 (2026-09-19) shows initial intent, but no invites and no key milestone since, and two Wrenfield outreaches (email:171bc82e, email:78c1d8df) got zero reply or tickets. Silent Starter account with 8 days left suggests low unaided odds, not zero given early activity.

draft.subject: Next step after your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Zara,

Following up on my note yesterday. You've already created your first project in Wrenfield, which is the main organizing unit, with tasks living inside them -- so the natural next step is getting the rest of Harbor Media in alongside you. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through whichever next step matters most to you, or just answer questions by reply.

Best,
Chidi
